rule a country: It is not easy to rule a country when people have very different ideas about the future.
當人民對未來有非常不同的想法時，要統治國家並不容易。
rule out the possibility: The police have not ruled out the possibility that the fire was started on purpose.
警方尚未排除這場火災是有人故意縱火的可能性。
rule in favor of: After hearing both sides, the judge decided to rule in favor of the young worker.
聽完雙方說法後，法官決定判決支持那名年輕員工。
rule the roost: In our house, my grandmother rules the roost, and everyone listens to what she says.
在我們家是奶奶當家作主，大家都聽她的話。
rule with an iron fist: The old king chose to rule with an iron fist, and anyone who disagreed was punished.
那位老國王選擇鐵腕統治，任何持不同意見的人都會受罰。
rule the market: For many years, this company's smartphones seemed to rule the market in Asia.
多年來，這家公司的智慧型手機似乎稱霸了亞洲市場。
it is rumored that: It is rumored that the famous singer will get married next month, but nobody knows if it's true.
據傳那位知名歌手下個月要結婚，但沒有人知道是不是真的。
be rumored to be: The quiet old man next door is rumored to be a millionaire, though he lives very simply.
隔壁那位安靜的老先生傳聞是百萬富翁，雖然他生活非常簡樸。
rumor has it: Rumor has it that our math teacher is leaving the school at the end of this semester.
據說我們的數學老師這學期結束後就要離開學校了。
spread rumors: Some students like to spread rumors online, which can really hurt other people's feelings.
有些學生喜歡在網路上散播謠言，這真的會傷害到別人的感受。
run a business: My aunt has run a business selling handmade soap for ten years, and it is very successful.
我阿姨經營販售手工肥皂的事業已經十年了，而且非常成功。
run for office: After working in the community for years, she finally decided to run for office as mayor.
在社區服務多年後，她終於決定出來競選市長。
run out of time: I never finish the last question on math tests because I always run out of time.
我數學考試從來寫不完最後一題，因為我總是時間用盡。
run the risk: If you don't wear a helmet, you run the risk of getting badly hurt in an accident.
如果你不戴安全帽，就要冒著在意外中受重傷的風險。
run a test: My computer keeps crashing, so the technician will run a test to find out what's wrong.
我的電腦一直當機，所以技術人員要做測試，找出哪裡出了問題。
run in the family: Both my mom and my grandpa are great singers, so musical talent seems to run in the family.
我媽媽和我外公都是很棒的歌手，所以音樂天分似乎是家族遺傳。
run a fever: If your child begins to run a fever, give him plenty of water and take him to a doctor.
如果你的孩子開始發燒，給他多喝水並帶他去看醫生。
run late: Sorry, I'm going to run late this morning because there's a terrible traffic jam on the highway.
抱歉，我今天早上會遲到，因為高速公路上大塞車。
run errands: On weekends, I often run errands for my grandmother, like buying groceries and paying bills.
週末時我常幫奶奶跑腿，像是買菜和繳帳單。
rush to judgment: We shouldn't rush to judgment before we hear the whole story from both people.
在聽兩個人把整件事說完之前，我們不應該匆促判斷。
rush a decision: Take your time and don't rush a decision like this; choosing a college is a big step.
慢慢來，不要倉促做這樣的決定；選大學是人生的一大步。
rush to the hospital: When Grandpa fell down the stairs, we had to rush to the hospital in the middle of the night.
爺爺從樓梯摔下來時，我們只好半夜趕往醫院。
rush into marriage: My parents told me not to rush into marriage just because all my friends are getting married.
我爸媽告訴我，不要只因為朋友們都結婚了就倉促結婚。
be rushed off one's feet: During the Lunar New Year, the restaurant staff were rushed off their feet from morning till night.
農曆新年期間，餐廳員工從早到晚都忙得不可開交。
rush hour: The MRT is always crowded during rush hour, so I try to leave home before seven.
尖峰時段捷運總是很擠，所以我盡量在七點前出門。
the engine rusted: The old car sat outside in the rain for years, and finally the engine rusted and stopped working.
那輛舊車在雨中擺了好多年，最後引擎生鏽，不能運轉了。
skills rust: Your piano skills rust quickly if you don't practice for several months.
如果你好幾個月不練習，你的鋼琴技能會很快生疏。
rusty English: My rusty English got better after I spent a month talking with travelers at the hostel.
我在青年旅館和旅客聊天一個月後，我生疏的英文變好了。
rust away: If you leave your bike outside near the sea, the metal parts will slowly rust away.
如果你把腳踏車放在海邊的戶外，金屬零件會慢慢鏽蝕掉。
